notifications:daily.reminder__note: Daily nudge. An invitation, never pressure. Max 60 chars.
notifications:streak.atRisk: {count, plural, one {Your streak is at # day. One lesson keeps it.} other {Your streak is at # days. One lesson keeps it.}}
notifications:streak.atRisk__note: Push notification. States the fact and offers the action. NEVER "Don't lose your streak!". Max 60 chars.
notifications:mastery.almost: {country} is almost mastered — one lesson to go.
notifications:mastery.almost__note: Push notification. {country} is a localised name. Max 60 chars.
notifications:comeback__note: Warm, never guilty. No 'we haven't seen you in 3 days'.
notifications:daily.title: Ready to explore?
notifications:daily.title__note: Bold first line of the daily reminder notification. An invitation, never pressure. Max 30 characters.
notifications:daily.anywhere__note: Used as {region} in notifications:daily.reminder when the user did not pick a continent to start in, giving 'The world is waiting. 5 minutes?'. Must read naturally as the subject of that sentence. Max 16 characters.
